name: ssh
label: ssh
description: SSH operations - run commands on and copy files to/from a remote machine (ssh_run, ssh_copy, ssh_status)

config_schema.label: SSH Dir (directory with ssh config + keys; default {OMNI_DIR}/data/ssh)
Workspace Dir (sandbox - local side of ssh_copy must stay inside)
Database URL (for resolving ssh_key_secret_name from the omniagent secrets store)
Default SSH Key Secret (secret name whose VALUE is the private key; empty = local key files only)
